name: Wolf Gold 4 Pack

features.name: Four-grid respins
features.description: The moon respin bonus is played on four 5x3 grids.

features.name: Gold moons
features.description: Unlock the bottom grids and reset respins on all grids.

review:
Wolf Gold's classic money respin, spread over four grids. You get there through the Bonus Wheel (three scatters) or by landing five or more moons.

The bottom two grids stay locked until a gold moon lands. Each moon resets its grid's three respins and sticks, while gold moons reset all four grids at once. At the end, every moon pays, plus 1,000x if every spot is filled. Six or more moons can start a Super Bonus. 96.51% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
